import clr, System, json
clr.AddReference('Grasshopper')
import Grasshopper as GH
r={}
for t in [GH.Kernel.GH_UserObject, GH.Kernel.GH_ComponentServer, GH.Kernel.GH_DocumentIO]:
 ct=clr.GetClrType(t)
 r[str(ct)]=[str(m) for m in ct.GetMethods() if any(s in m.Name for s in ['Instantiate','Emit','Read','Save','Open','SetPersistent'])]
 r[str(ct)+'_constructors']=[str(c) for c in ct.GetConstructors()]
print(json.dumps(r))
